points: The children of Israel did evil again in the sight of the Most High, and he strengthened Eglon the king of Moab against Israel because they had done evil.

note.label: Judges 3: Nations Left to Prove Israel

points: It is a constant cycle: Israel does evil, the Most High strengthens an enemy against us, and we are put under him. Eglon took the city of palm trees and Israel served him eighteen years.

Eglon was a very fat man, and that is why the dagger had to be a cubit — he had to thrust it in. For eighteen years Israel watched that man walk down the street taking their taxes, and now some of you are moving like Eglon.
